title: Computation counits for the completed-coefficient ordinary scalar associator
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E,L,M$ be finite-dimensional extension fields of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, let $i:E\to L$ and $j:L\to M$ be $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra maps, and let $T$ be a scheme. Write $a,b,c$ for the completed coefficient-sheaf maps of $i,j,ji$, $F_a,F_b,F_c$ for their ordinary sheafified scalar extensions, $L_a,L_b,L_c$ for their specified ordinary derived extensions, and $\varepsilon_a(P):L_aQ(P)\to Q(F_aP)$ for their cochain computation counits. Let $\alpha:L_bL_a\simeq L_c$ be the adjunction-normalized derived scalar associator and $\bar\alpha:F_bF_a\simeq F_c$ the adjunction-normalized ordinary sheaf associator. For every cochain complex $P$ of integral coefficient modules over $E$, $\alpha_{Q(P)}\varepsilon_c(P)=L_b(\varepsilon_a(P))\varepsilon_b(F_aP)Q(\bar\alpha_P)$, with compositions read from left to right and $\bar\alpha_P$ the termwise scalar associator.

proof.text: Insert the three exact-localization model isomorphisms. The existing composition equation expresses alpha followed by the direct model as the first model extended through L_b, the second model, and the localized ordinary associator.

The exact-functor composition and natural-isomorphism factorization equations express the localized ordinary associator followed by its direct factor map as the successive factor maps and Q of the termwise ordinary associator.

Use naturality of the second model isomorphism to move the first factor map left, then combine it with the first model inside L_b. Each resulting model followed by its factor map is the specified computation counit.

theorem completedScalarTensorAssociatorCounit
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ) :
    (PurCompactSupport.tensorComposition _ _ _
      (PurCompactSupport.completedMap_composition l E L i M j T)).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
      pbcComplexCounit (completedCoefficientMap l E M (j.comp i) T) P =
    (pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l L M j T)).map
      (pbcComplexCounit (completedCoefficientMap l E L i T) P) ≫
    pbcComplexCounit (completedCoefficientMap l L M j T)
      (((pbcExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L i T)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
      ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
          (PurStrictScalar.ordinaryScalarAssociator _ _ _
            (PurCompactSupport.completedMap_composition l E L i M j T)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
